T01.subject: Generic integer representation and range/error policy
T01.owner: Bosak core/runtime maintainer; C13 owner disposition
T01.status: Explicit implementation limit, not a blanket malformed-input claim
T01.boundary: Valid decimal-backed wide literals can still fail xs:integer string/numeric constructor/cast narrowing with FORG0001; castable is false. Distinguish storage limits, invalid lexical input, numeric overflow and derived facets. Do not globally replace error codes.

T02.subject: Decimal precision and numeric consumers
T02.owner: Bosak numeric maintainer; C13 owner disposition
T02.boundary: Fixed .NET decimal precision can round away fractional/significant digits. Delivered rounding/arithmetic/unsigned fixes do not implement arbitrary-precision decimals or all extended-year consumers.

T03.subject: Schema list/union/namespace contexts
T03.owner: C03 retained schema evidence; C06 host/context review
T03.status: Supported named cases with explicit remaining scope
T03.boundary: List constructors return sequences of item types; list names are not valid ordinary item-test targets. Imported types require the supplied schema/type/namespace context. No global schema availability, full XSD loader, generic list typing or skip removal follows.

T04.subject: Nominal/structural/default/static record context
T04.owner: C05/C06 and final C09-C12 per-entry review
T04.status: Bounded supported forms and unclaimed remainder
T04.boundary: Defaults and static field initialization are verified in specific constructors/bindings. Package/visibility/recursive/global-initializer/override/update/cast combinations remain unaccepted, rather than labeled universally unsupported.

T05.subject: Function signatures, focus capture and BC propagation
T05.status: Bounded controls, not generic conversion certification
T05.boundary: Direct/ref/lookup focus constructors, scalar cardinality and selected typed functions pass. Paired compile/runtime BC flags are explicit. Arbitrary schema callbacks, function variance, dynamic host propagation and all error-eagerness combinations require their own applicable evidence.

F08-atomic-annotation-empty.boundary: atomic-type-annotation(()) returns a record in both 4.0 profiles although the argument is required. C03 does not overwrite its independent XPTY0004 expectations or count it as supported coercion.

evidencePolicy: Controls retain their exact expected values/error markers. Fresh probes and 245 focused unit tests supplement unchanged C02 full-solution/catalog results. Diagnostics, type membership and example passage do not establish arbitrary precision, full schema/host/type conversion or entry/criterion acceptance.
